_overridesComment: next bundles postcss 8.4.31 and sharp 0.34.5, both carrying advisories
GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj, the libvips CVEs). No published Next release ships
patched versions, so `npm audit fix --force` proposes next@9.3.3 — a
seven-major downgrade that would destroy the app. NEVER run it here.
sharp matters in production: Next optimises remote images at runtime and
users upload their own images to the allowed Cloudinary host, so a
crafted upload would reach libvips. These overrides are the surgical fix;
sharp is pushed past next's declared ^0.34.5, which is why the build and
the /_next/image path are verified whenever they change.
